**Finding submitted: DEVIATION (WARRANTY)**

**What the document does.** Article VIX is a pure disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS," all warranties "WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED" are disclaimed (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, completeness, accuracy, title), and Licensor expressly does not warrant error-free or uninterrupted operation, or that nonconformity to the Documentation can or will be corrected.

**Why it fails.** There is no affirmative performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the agreement. The nearest thing — Article VII(f) Error Corrections — only obliges Licensor to use "commercially reasonable efforts," which is a support undertaking, not a warranty, and gives us no repair, replace or refund remedy. This is squarely the playbook's walk-away position and does not reach even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).

**Redline (validated, ok:true).**
1. `p0110` — open the disclaimer with "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH BELOW IN THIS ARTICLE," so the disclaimer no longer swallows the warranty.
2. Insert after `p0116` — an express warranty: professional and workmanlike services; 12-month conformance of the Licensed Technology to the Documentation and Specifications; no malicious code; compliance with applicable laws; with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund of fees paid as the remedy.

The comment flags the 90/30-day fallback as an acceptable landing zone if the Licensor pushes back on the 12-month period.
